SELECT PAYMENT_METHOD_NO, MEMBER_NO, PAYMENT_TYPE, BANK_CODE,
CASE BANK_CODE WHEN 'SHINHAN' THEN '신한은행' WHEN 'KB' THEN 'KB국민은행' WHEN 'WOORI' THEN '우리은행' WHEN 'NH' THEN 'NH농협은행' WHEN 'HANA' THEN '하나은행' WHEN 'KAKAO' THEN '카카오뱅크' WHEN 'TOSS' THEN '토스뱅크' ELSE BANK_CODE END AS BANK_NAME,
ACCOUNT_LAST4, ACCOUNT_HOLDER, PAYMENT_DEFAULT
FROM PAYMENT_METHOD
WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND PAYMENT_TYPE = 'BANK'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN PAYMENT_DEFAULT = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT PAYMENT_METHOD_NO, MEMBER_NO, PAYMENT_TYPE, CARD_COMPANY,
CASE CARD_COMPANY WHEN 'BC' THEN '비씨카드' WHEN 'KB' THEN 'KB국민카드' WHEN 'SHINHAN' THEN '신한카드' WHEN 'SAMSUNG' THEN '삼성카드' WHEN 'HYUNDAI' THEN '현대카드' WHEN 'LOTTE' THEN '롯데카드' WHEN 'HANA' THEN '하나카드' WHEN 'WOORI' THEN '우리카드' WHEN 'NH' THEN 'NH농협카드' ELSE CARD_COMPANY END AS CARD_COMPANY_NAME,
CARD_LAST4, PAYMENT_DEFAULT
FROM PAYMENT_METHOD
WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND PAYMENT_TYPE = 'CARD'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN PAYMENT_DEFAULT = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT PAYMENT_METHOD_NO, MEMBER_NO, PAYMENT_TYPE, BANK_CODE,
CASE BANK_CODE WHEN 'SHINHAN' THEN '신한은행' WHEN 'KB' THEN 'KB국민은행' WHEN 'WOORI' THEN '우리은행' WHEN 'NH' THEN 'NH농협은행' WHEN 'HANA' THEN '하나은행' WHEN 'KAKAO' THEN '카카오뱅크' WHEN 'TOSS' THEN '토스뱅크' ELSE BANK_CODE END AS BANK_NAME,
ACCOUNT_LAST4, ACCOUNT_HOLDER, CARD_COMPANY, CARD_LAST4, PAYMENT_DEFAULT
FROM PAYMENT_METHOD
WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN PAYMENT_DEFAULT = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, PAYMENT_METHOD_NO DESC
SELECT PAYMENT_METHOD_NO, MEMBER_NO, PAYMENT_TYPE, PAYMENT_DEFAULT FROM PAYMENT_METHOD WHERE PAYMENT_METHOD_NO = #{paymentMethodNo} AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
